comment: How the French recording (out/audios, ElevenLabs, 2026-09-28) sits on the pictures. Times are seconds inside each source file, read from its loudness curve. `anchor` moves a line so that the word at `at` lands on scene beat `beat`; `lead` is the pause before the line starts; `marks` become scene beats that the scenes read with useMarks(). "longestPause" means where speech resumes after the file's longest pause.
